label: P0 — Keep features 017/020/022 out of FEATURES and auto-on paths: the registry has only four proven entries, none a candidate, while unset switches default on and featureReady then checks credentials. Adding an unproven candidate could make it execute on credentialed installations.

P0 — Route a future consumer through featureReady and preserve an explicit baseline fallback; existing consumers have distinct patterns, and cite-drift still uses featureSwitch plus a custom readiness check. Shared-helper tests do not prove each consumer preserves pre-Jev output on provider failures.

P1 — Use a common evidence standard but retain feature-specific eligibility and verdicts: the scorers share reporting support and paired-statistic ingredients, but their data populations, replay gates, abstention classes, and local verdict functions differ, so a keep is not semantically interchangeable across features.

P1 — Before shadow/canary/live, require time-separated real usage, independent labels, a predeclared strongest-safe baseline, adequate pre-registered power, absolute and class-specific floors, and passing negative controls; distinguish a valid kill from stops caused by insufficient eligible evidence.

P1 — Rank the next tests 022 masked-state ablation, 020 consented clarification census plus shadow user-pick labels, 017 powered real Gate 1 holdout. None qualifies for live integration today; require its exact feature-specific evidence artifact before promotion.
